description.value: Clos du Soleil is a small artisan winery and estate vineyard on the Upper Bench of the South Similkameen Valley, producing ultra-premium Bordeaux-inspired wines from organically farmed, biodynamic vineyards since 2006. The tasting room invites visitors to tour the vineyard and taste wines that express the rocky, sun-drenched character of this distinctive Similkameen microclimate. A natural destination stop for cyclists touring this scenic valley corridor, the winery's organic credentials and welcoming hospitality ethos set it apart from larger commercial operations.
